senses.gloss:
गृष्टि गृष्टि, इस्, f. a cow which has had
only one calf, a young cow; (in compounds with the
names of other animals) any young female animal
(e. g. वासिता-गृष्टि, a young female elephant); a
kind of bulbous plant, = वाराही, वराह-कान्ता,
बदरा; Zizyphus Jujuba (?), Gmelinus Arborea,
= काश्मरी; (इस्), m. a boar (various reading for
घृष्टि).
गृष्टि; under ‘इस्, m.’ add — a proper N.
गृष्टिका, f. a kind of plant.
